title: Per-hop price-limit propagation and on-chain current-state validation

changes.change: The three-state verdict publishes the three current tick price limits in route order. A review without all three limits does not create an automatic broadcast request.
A broadcast request without all three price limits is refused before an execution attempt is created; the attempt persists the limits used.

Both mainnet and testnet executor packages build bounded PoolManager calldata, read the current slot0/liquidity through extsload, and reject a limit on the wrong side of the current price before execution.
The Rust broadcast path fail-closes a payload without three hop price limits instead of falling back to the global V4 price bound.

parity.finalInputAmount: The reviewed selectedAmountRaw is the single amount used by every hop's single-tick and three-state gate; the review and broadcast request carry the same three limits.
parity.machineEvidence: The review-manager regression test the_broadcast_request_carries_the_proved_hop_price_limits asserts three parseable limits and equality between the review row and the broadcast request.
parity.reason: No production broadcast or mainnet state-changing call was authorized; only deterministic local contract tests were run.

failClosed: A review without three price limits creates no automatic broadcast request.
A broadcast request without three price limits is refused.
A Rust payload without three price limits is skipped before signing.
A PoolManager state read failure reverts with V4PoolStateUnavailable.
A limit on the wrong side of the current price reverts with V4PriceLimitWrongDirection.
The global V4 price bounds are refused as current-tick limits.
remaining: The deployed mainnet arbiter ABI cannot accept per-hop price limits; the production broadcast path still requires the bounded executor deployment or a reviewed arbiter upgrade.
Exact on-chain favorable/unchanged/adverse output classification still requires the same SDK math on-chain; the current contract validates current state, tick direction and liquidity presence.
Batch isolation for multiple independently profitable closed loops is not yet implemented end to end; the broadcast manager accepts multiple attempts but each chain transaction remains independent.
Mainnet live three-hop input parity remains unexecuted because production calls were not authorized.

pythonFull.assessment: Failures are outside the hop-price-limit change surface and are concentrated in existing configuration, architecture guards, runtime database fixtures, and migration isolation tests; the focused Rust bridge suite passes.
